parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id
)
SELECT
  input.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  jobs.id AS job_id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.last_error,
  jobs.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  COUNT(scenes.id)::int AS scene_count,
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'scene_id', scenes.id,
        'scene_number', scenes.scene_number,
        'narration', scenes.narration,
        'visual_description', scenes.visual_description,
        'visual_query', scenes.visual_query,
        'visual_subject_type', scenes.visual_subject_type,
        'audio_path', scenes.audio_path,
        'duration_seconds', scenes.duration_seconds,
        'visual_path', scenes.visual_path,
        'status', scenes.status,
        'asset_count', (
          SELECT COUNT(*)::int
          FROM public.assets assets
          WHERE assets.scene_id = scenes.id
        )
      )
      ORDER BY scenes.scene_number
    ) FILTER (WHERE scenes.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS scenes
FROM input
LEFT JOIN public.jobs
  ON jobs.id = input.job_id
LEFT JOIN public.scenes
  ON scenes.job_id = jobs.id
GROUP BY
  input.job_id,
  jobs.id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.last_error;

parameters.jsCode: const transition=$input.first().json; const job=$('Require Eligible Visual Job').first().json; if(transition.ready_to_run!==true) throw new Error(`Job ${job.job_id} could not enter or resume visuals stage`); if(String(transition.job_id)!==String(job.job_id)) throw new Error('Visual stage transition job_id mismatch'); if(transition.status!=='processing'||transition.current_stage!=='visuals') throw new Error(`Unexpected visual state: status=${transition.status}, current_stage=${transition.current_stage}`); const pendingScenes=job.scenes.filter(scene=>!(typeof scene.visual_path==='string'?scene.visual_path.trim():'')); if(pendingScenes.length===0) throw new Error(`Job ${job.job_id} has no pending visual scenes`); return pendingScenes.map(scene=>({json:{job_id:job.job_id,scene_id:scene.scene_id,scene_number:Number(scene.scene_number),narration:scene.narration.trim(),visual_description:scene.visual_description.trim(),visual_query:scene.visual_query.trim(),visual_subject_type:scene.visual_subject_type}}));

const scene=$('Prepare Visual Items').item.json; const errorItem=$json??{}; let reason=errorItem.error?.message||errorItem.error?.description||errorItem.errorMessage||errorItem.message||'Pixabay search failed'; return {json:{...scene,fallback_reason:String(reason).slice(0,1000)}};
const item=$json; if(item.candidate_found!==true||typeof item.download_url!=='string'||item.download_url.trim()==='') throw new Error('Selected visual candidate is incomplete'); return {json:item};

const visualPath=typeof $json.visual_path==='string'?$json.visual_path.trim():''; const width=Number($json.width),height=Number($json.height),bytes=Number($json.bytes); if(!visualPath)throw new Error('media-worker response is missing visual_path'); if(!Number.isFinite(width)||width<=0||!Number.isFinite(height)||height<=0)throw new Error('media-worker returned invalid visual dimensions'); if(!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error('media-worker returned invalid visual byte size'); return {json:{...$json,visual_path:visualPath,width,height,bytes}};

const stored=$json; const selected=$('Prepare Selected Download').item.json; return {json:{job_id:selected.job_id,scene_id:selected.scene_id,scene_number:selected.scene_number,provider:selected.provider,provider_asset_id:selected.provider_asset_id||null,source_url:selected.source_url||null,author:selected.author||null,license:selected.license||null,license_url:selected.license_url||null,visual_path:stored.visual_path,metadata:{...(selected.metadata??{}),normalized_width:Number(stored.width),normalized_height:Number(stored.height),normalized_codec:stored.codec_name??null,normalized_bytes:Number(stored.bytes),source_content_type:stored.source_content_type??null,stored_by:'media-worker'}}};

const selected=$('Prepare Selected Download').item.json; const errorItem=$json??{}; const candidates=[errorItem.error?.message,errorItem.error?.description,errorItem.error,errorItem.errorMessage,errorItem.message]; let message=candidates.find(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()!==''); if(!message){try{message=JSON.stringify(errorItem)}catch{message='External visual download/store failed'}} return {json:{...selected,retry_pexels:selected.provider==='pixabay',fallback_reason:String(message||'External visual failed').trim().slice(0,1000)}};

const scene=$('Prepare Visual Items').item.json; const incoming=$json??{}; const candidates=[incoming.fallback_reason,incoming.error?.message,incoming.error?.description,incoming.error,incoming.errorMessage,incoming.message]; let reason=candidates.find(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()!==''); if(!reason)reason='No acceptable external visual asset was available'; return {json:{...scene,fallback_reason:String(reason).trim().slice(0,1000)}};

const visualPath=typeof $json.visual_path==='string'?$json.visual_path.trim():''; const width=Number($json.width),height=Number($json.height),bytes=Number($json.bytes); if($json.fallback!==true||!visualPath)throw new Error('media-worker fallback response is invalid'); if(!Number.isFinite(width)||width<=0||!Number.isFinite(height)||height<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error('media-worker fallback dimensions/bytes are invalid'); return {json:{...$json,visual_path:visualPath,width,height,bytes}};

const stored=$json; const scene=$('Prepare Fallback Context').item.json; return {json:{job_id:scene.job_id,scene_id:scene.scene_id,scene_number:scene.scene_number,provider:'local_fallback',provider_asset_id:null,source_url:null,author:null,license:null,license_url:null,visual_path:stored.visual_path,metadata:{fallback:true,reason:scene.fallback_reason,normalized_width:Number(stored.width),normalized_height:Number(stored.height),normalized_codec:stored.codec_name??null,normalized_bytes:Number(stored.bytes),stored_by:'media-worker'}}};

parameters.query: WITH target_scene AS (SELECT id FROM public.scenes WHERE id=$1::uuid AND job_id=$2::uuid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(visual_path),'') IS NULL FOR UPDATE), inserted AS (INSERT INTO public.assets(scene_id,provider,provider_asset_id,source_url,author,license,license_url,local_path,metadata) SELECT $1::uuid,$3::text,NULLIF($4::text,''),NULLIF($5::text,''),NULLIF($6::text,''),NULLIF($7::text,''),NULLIF($8::text,''),$9::text,$10::jsonb FROM target_scene WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.assets WHERE scene_id=$1::uuid) RETURNING id), updated AS (UPDATE public.scenes SET visual_path=$9::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND job_id=$2::uuid AND NULLIF(BTRIM($9::text),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) RETURNING id,job_id,scene_number,visual_path) SELECT $1::uuid AS scene_id,$2::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS asset_inserted,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS scene_updated,(SELECT id FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS asset_id,(SELECT scene_number FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS scene_number,(SELECT visual_path FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS visual_path,(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated)) AS persisted;

WITH job_state AS (SELECT id,status,current_stage,target_duration_seconds,CASE target_duration_seconds WHEN 15 THEN 4 WHEN 30 THEN 8 WHEN 45 THEN 12 WHEN 60 THEN 15 ELSE NULL END AS required_scene_count FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid), scene_state AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_scene_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(scenes.visual_path),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.assets WHERE assets.scene_id=scenes.id))::int AS ready_scene_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(scenes.visual_path),'') IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.assets WHERE assets.scene_id=scenes.id))::int AS incomplete_scene_count FROM public.scenes scenes WHERE scenes.job_id=$1::uuid) SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_state) AS job_exists,job_state.status,job_state.current_stage,job_state.target_duration_seconds,job_state.required_scene_count,scene_state.total_scene_count,scene_state.ready_scene_count,scene_state.incomplete_scene_count,(job_state.status='processing' AND job_state.current_stage='visuals' AND job_state.required_scene_count IS NOT NULL AND scene_state.total_scene_count=job_state.required_scene_count AND scene_state.ready_scene_count=job_state.required_scene_count AND scene_state.incomplete_scene_count=0) AS all_visuals_ready FROM job_state CROSS JOIN scene_state;

parameters.jsCode: const result=$json; if(!result.job_exists) throw new Error(`Job ${result.job_id} was not found during visual completion check`); if(result.status!=='processing'||result.current_stage!=='visuals') throw new Error(`Unexpected job state after visuals: status=${result.status}, current_stage=${result.current_stage}`); if(result.all_visuals_ready!==true) throw new Error(`Visual sourcing is incomplete for job ${result.job_id}: ready=${result.ready_scene_count}, total=${result.total_scene_count}, required=${result.required_scene_count}, incomplete=${result.incomplete_scene_count}`); return {json:{job_id:result.job_id,status:result.status,current_stage:result.current_stage,scene_count:Number(result.total_scene_count),visuals_complete:true}};

const errorItem=$input.first()?.json??{}; const job=$('Require Eligible Visual Job').first().json; if(typeof job.job_id!=='string'||job.job_id.trim()==='') throw new Error('Validated job_id is unavailable while recording visual failure'); const candidates=[errorItem.error?.message,errorItem.error?.description,errorItem.error,errorItem.errorMessage,errorItem.errorDescription,errorItem.message]; let message=candidates.find(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()!==''); if(!message){try{message=JSON.stringify(errorItem)}catch{message=''}} message=String(message||'Unknown visual sourcing stage failure').trim().slice(0,4000); return [{json:{job_id:job.job_id,last_error:message}}];

parameters.query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='visuals',last_error=CASE WHEN status='failed' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(last_error),'') IS NOT NULL THEN last_error ELSE LEFT($2::text,4000) END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND current_stage='visuals' AND status IN ('processing','failed') RETURNING id,status,current_stage,last_error) SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS failure_recorded,(SELECT status FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS status,(SELECT current_stage FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,COALESCE((SELECT last_error FROM updated LIMIT 1),LEFT($2::text,4000)) AS last_error;
